reply_text:
I replied to Dana in your DM. Moss's notes have two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Doors 14–18) weren't getting text messages with their dock assignments when they checked in at the gate. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and the customer confirmed it was working the next morning.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). Gate barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to second-level support to test the scanner firmware.

I read all six of Moss's notes. The other four have no Quarrendon ticket numbers: two mention the account without one, and two are about Central team accounts.

I also told Dana that Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025 (not one of Moss's) uses #4419 for a different problem: slow printouts at Gate 3. The notes don't show which description is right, so I suggested Dana check with Marcus or support before putting #4419 in the weekly notes.

Moss's notes are shared files, so Dana can read them. I didn't use any channels Dana isn't in.
